audit_metadata.purpose: Theory-to-measurement bridge review; not scientific validation
audit_metadata.evidence_limits: No participant data downloaded; no third-party code executed; public sources only

claims.statement: Algebraic-topological operators (simplicial complexes, persistent homology) applied to EEG/fMRI functional connectivity measure biologically meaningful higher-order interactions beyond pairwise dependence.

strongest_primary_source.citation: Giusti C, Ghrist R, Bassett DS. Two’s company, three (or more) is a simplex. J Comput Neurosci. 2016;41:1-14.
strongest_primary_source.note: Supports mathematical encoding of non-dyadic relations; does not establish recovery from EEG sensors.

claims.falsifiable_prediction_or_disconfirming_: On independent preregistered EEG data, higher-order descriptors must outperform pairwise + matched nulls (phase-randomized, spatial-surrogate) after source-space vs sensor-space control. Failure disconfirms operational claim.
claims.evidence_limit: Literature audit set supported_for_repository=false; this review does not upgrade.

claims.statement: PITNN features that pass formal Bayes-factor gate K>100 identify a topological mechanism in EEG.

strongest_primary_source.citation: Repository scientific falsification contract and prior execution: PITNN K>100 gate failed 20/20 on ds005620.
strongest_primary_source.note: Gate failure is the available empirical result; proxy K is not formal Bayes factor.

claims.falsifiable_prediction_or_disconfirming_: Independent dataset, locked pipeline, formal K>100 with pairwise baselines, full provenance, sensitivity to filtering/montage. Current result disconfirms on that dataset.
claims.evidence_limit: Does not promote any result; failure stands.

claims.statement: Open quantum system simulations of Fröhlich condensation, Diósi-Penrose effects, or exceptional points produce descriptors that measure biological quantum or critical phenomena in macroscopic EEG.

strongest_primary_source.citation: Theoretical physics literature on Fröhlich condensates and exceptional points; prior review verdict that layers are speculative and not empirically identifiable from available EEG/fMRI.
strongest_primary_source.note: No peer-reviewed primary source demonstrates identification from standard EEG/fMRI.

assumptions: Quantum coherence timescales survive to macroscopic sensors
EP or gravitational effects detectable above thermal noise
counterevidence_or_uncertainty: Classical nonlinear models can produce similar descriptors
claims.falsifiable_prediction_or_disconfirming_: Biophysical parameter constraints must be matched and a classical null model of equal complexity must fail to reproduce the same EEG topological statistics under the same forward model.

claims.statement: Graph cycle rank (beta-1) computed on functional connectivity equals or measures spatial winding number / topological charge.

strongest_primary_source.note: Supports the mathematical distinction; prohibits identification.

counterevidence_or_uncertainty: Threshold, lag, source vs sensor yield different beta-1
Spatial winding requires continuous field not recovered by cycle rank
alternative_explanations: Cycle rank as connectivity complexity measure only
claims.falsifiable_prediction_or_disconfirming_: Compute both quantities on the same data under controlled embeddings; systematic divergence under montage or inverse changes disconfirms identity.

claims.statement: Preprints on triadic FC, higher-order spectra, and related construct papers support PITNN, topological charge, or quantum-layer claims.

strongest_primary_source.citation: docs/research/higher_order_literature_audit.md on origin/main; all five identifiers confirmed, all supported_for_repository=false.

counterevidence_or_uncertainty: No EEG topology or quantum identification
alternative_explanations: Independent methodological contributions that do not license repository mechanistic claims
claims.falsifiable_prediction_or_disconfirming_: Independent replication that simultaneously satisfies the repository’s falsification contract (K>100, provenance, nulls). Current audit disconfirms the upgrade.
claims.evidence_limit: Explicit downgrade; this review does not upgrade.

unknowns: Whether any higher-order descriptor survives rigorous pairwise + spatial-surrogate nulls in source space on independent data.
Whether formal K>100 can be obtained under the full falsification contract on any real dataset.
Whether classical models of equal complexity can reproduce topological statistics attributed to quantum or EP layers.
Precise contribution of volume conduction versus genuine higher-order interactions under realistic forward models.
Independent replication status of the cited preprints.
non_promotion: This artifact does not introduce VALIDATED status. No claim is promoted. Completion of the audit does not establish that any scientific hypothesis is true.
